meta.name: Pulse 2025
meta.description:
A group of ER residents navigate medical crises and personal drama amid a divisive allegation at their Miami hospital.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Abby
videos.overview: As a hurricane bears down on Miami, things are equally stormy in the Maguire ER, where a serious allegation has opened rifts between the residents.

videos.title: Alone Time
videos.overview: The worsening storm overwhelms the ER, forcing Danny to make tough choices. Tom must rise to the occasion when someone close to him is injured.

videos.title: Power
videos.overview: As the hospital's backup generators run low, Dr. Cruz worries for Vero's safety. Sophie and Camila risk it all to save a patient in danger.

videos.title: Treat ‘Em and Street ‘Em
videos.overview: With the ER at capacity post-storm, Danny struggles to balance a full caseload and the arrival of a new attending — who has a history with Xander.

videos.title: Nothing Personal
videos.overview: A charismatic sheriff's deputy sets his sights on Danny. A young patient's demanding parents make things hard for Harper. Sophie faces a moral dilemma.

videos.title: Homestead
videos.overview: A hometown visit to their difficult father reopens fault lines between Danny and Harper. Tom and Dr. Soriano's day off takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Choices
videos.overview: Danny and Sam undergo Dr. Cruz's scrutiny as she prepares to choose next year's chief resident. Camila looks for clues to a girl's mysterious illness.

videos.title: Retreat
videos.overview: As they await an interview with HR, Danny and Xander reckon with their painful past. A crisis brings Tom's divided loyalties to light.

videos.title: The Last Shift
videos.overview: A nightclub fire floods the ER with patients. With Danny's career hanging in the balance, Dr. Cruz must make a difficult decision.

videos.title: Kennedy
videos.overview: Xander comes clean about what really happened at his former hospital. A new academic year brings a new chief resident — and new challenges in the ER.

meta.slogan: Life can change in a heartbeat.
